title: Timeline events table schema and migration
description: Define the timeline_events table that stores all project history events. This is the core of the timeline feature — every significant action (journal entry, milestone completion, GitHub commit, progress change, etc.) is logged here.
acceptanceCriteria: FK to projects.id with cascade delete
type ENUM covers all 8 event types
payload JSONB column stores event-specific data
ref_id nullable UUID for linking to source records

steps.description: Define event type enum and timeline_events table
steps.details: Create server/src/db/schema/timelineEvents.ts. Define timelineEventTypeEnum = pgEnum('timeline_event_type', ['journal', 'milestone_completed', 'todo_batch', 'github_commit', 'github_release', 'progress_change', 'points_change', 'status_change']). Define timeline_events table: id (uuid pk), project_id (uuid notNull FK cascade delete), type (timelineEventTypeEnum notNull), ref_id (uuid nullable — FK to source record ID), payload (jsonb notNull default '{}'), created_at (timestamp notNull defaultNow()).
Add index on project_id and created_at together as a composite index (project_id, created_at DESC) for efficient paginated timeline queries. Add index on type for filtering.

steps.description: Export types and update schema barrel
steps.details: Export type TimelineEvent and type NewTimelineEvent. Add 'export * from ./timelineEvents' to schema/index.ts.
Run 'npm run db:migrate'. Verify timeline_events table with \d timeline_events. Confirm JSONB column type and composite index.

technicalNotes: JSONB allows storing different payload shapes per event type without schema changes
payload examples: journal: {entryId, title, mood}, milestone_completed: {milestoneId, name, points}, progress_change: {from, to, isManual}
The composite index (project_id, created_at DESC) is critical for pagination performance
